title: Both Buddha Dal and Taruna Dal

blocks.text: Dohra:
As Buddha Dal occupied the Doaba region, Taruna Dal occupied the region across the Ravi.
As two-three Singh Misls occupied Doaba, The Mughals had to face an ignominious defeat. (1)
lines: As two-three Singh Misls occupied Doaba,
The Mughals had to face an ignominious defeat.

blocks.text: S. Charat Singh1 , after occupying Gujranwala, He started invading the other surrounding areas. The route to Kabul getting blocked with Gujranwala's occupation, There spread a great panic in the whole country. (2)
lines: S.
Charat Singh1 , after occupying Gujranwala,
He started invading the other surrounding areas.
The route to Kabul getting blocked with Gujranwala's occupation,
There spread a great panic in the whole country.

blocks.text: Chaupai:

As this panic spread through out the whole countryside, Highly incensed did the Lahore Nawab feel at this rumour. Advancing with the heavy artillery guns in toe, The Lahore Nawab laid a siege to the city of Gujranwala. (3)
lines: As this panic spread through out the whole countryside,
Highly incensed did the Lahore Nawab feel at this rumour.
Advancing with the heavy artillery guns in toe,
The Lahore Nawab laid a siege to the city of Gujranwala.

blocks.text: As thirty thousand troops cordoned the entire city, One thousand Singhs got trapped inside the city. Though the Singhs were in minority against the Mughal majority, Yet the morale of the Mughal troops was at the lowest ebb. (4)
lines: As thirty thousand troops cordoned the entire city,
One thousand Singhs got trapped inside the city.
Though the Singhs were in minority against the Mughal majority,
Yet the morale of the Mughal troops was at the lowest ebb.

blocks.text: Deploying their artillery guns on the one flank, The Mughal troops encircled the city from three sides. As nobody could enter the city under the Mughal siege, The strength of Mughal troops kept on increasing. (5)
lines: Deploying their artillery guns on the one flank,
The Mughal troops encircled the city from three sides.
As nobody could enter the city under the Mughal siege,
The strength of Mughal troops kept on increasing.

blocks.text: Then did the Singhs feel really in a bind, Highly concerned did they feel at this development. Thereafter, did S. Charat Singh make up his mind, Must the Singhs rush out breaking through the Mughal cordon. (6)
lines: Then did the Singhs feel really in a bind,
Highly concerned did they feel at this development.
Thereafter, did S.
Charat Singh make up his mind,
Must the Singhs rush out breaking through the Mughal cordon.

blocks.text: Dohra:

There being a (Sikh) soldier in the pay of Lahore Nawab, Who conveyed the following message (to S. Charat Singh): Two hundred Sikh soldiers had he under his command, Who would join S. Charat Singh's force (at an opportune moment). (7)
lines: There being a (Sikh) soldier in the pay of Lahore Nawab,
Who conveyed the following message (to S.
Charat Singh): Two hundred Sikh soldiers had he under his command,
Who would join S.
Charat Singh's force (at an opportune moment).

blocks.text: Chaupai:

The moment S. Charat Singh's force came under Mughal attack, Those Sikh soldiers would rush to their aid soon. So much was S. Charat Singh feared by the Mughal troops, They dared not attack his contingent directly. (8)
lines: The moment S.
Charat Singh's force came under Mughal attack,
Those Sikh soldiers would rush to their aid soon.
So much was S.
Charat Singh feared by the Mughal troops,
They dared not attack his contingent directly.

blocks.text: If some Singhs could attack the Mughals from outside, Those paid Sikh soldiers would also join those plunderers. Perchance, it came to happen as they had proposed, As there spread rumours about the Khalsa's arrival. (9)
lines: If some Singhs could attack the Mughals from outside,
Those paid Sikh soldiers would also join those plunderers.
Perchance, it came to happen as they had proposed,
As there spread rumours about the Khalsa's arrival.

blocks.text: Thereafter, these enlisted Sikh soldiers approached the Nawab, Much did they scare the Nawab about Khalsa's approach. In a body would the Khalsa come in full force, All entries for Nawab's escape to Lahore would they block. (10)
lines: Thereafter, these enlisted Sikh soldiers approached the Nawab,
Much did they scare the Nawab about Khalsa's approach.
In a body would the Khalsa come in full force,
All entries for Nawab's escape to Lahore would they block.

blocks.text: Must the Nawab escape if he wished to survive, The worst fate awaited him if he missed the chance. Extremely nervous did the Nawab feel after this news, Thoroughly shaken and concerned did he feel indeed. (11)
lines: Must the Nawab escape if he wished to survive,
The worst fate awaited him if he missed the chance.
Extremely nervous did the Nawab feel after this news,
Thoroughly shaken and concerned did he feel indeed.

blocks.text: Dohra:

Thereafter, around two hundred Singhs attacked, As the darkness of night descended on the scene. Slaughtering and killing through the enemy lines, Did those Singhs succeed in reaching S. Charat Singh. (12)
lines: Thereafter, around two hundred Singhs attacked,
As the darkness of night descended on the scene.
Slaughtering and killing through the enemy lines,
Did those Singhs succeed in reaching S.
Charat Singh.

blocks.text: Chaupai:

Realising the veracity of the enlisted Singhs' information, Same night did the Lahore Nawab take to his heels. Those enlisted Singhs who were on the Nawab's payroll, Looting and plundering did they start from within. (13)
lines: Realising the veracity of the enlisted Singhs' information,
Same night did the Lahore Nawab take to his heels.
Those enlisted Singhs who were on the Nawab's payroll,
Looting and plundering did they start from within.

blocks.text: Abandoned and unguarded remained the artillery, As the Nawab managed to escape alone on his horse. Hearing this, S. Charat Singh gave him a hot chase, Much slaughtering and thrashing did they do on the way. (14)
lines: Abandoned and unguarded remained the artillery,
As the Nawab managed to escape alone on his horse.
Hearing this,
S.
Charat Singh gave him a hot chase,
Much slaughtering and thrashing did they do on the way.

blocks.text: As the Nawab made good his escape towards Lahore, The Singhs rushed after him in hot pursuit. As plenty of treasure landed into S. Charat Singh's hands, Many more Singhs joined S. Charat Singh's contingent. (15)
lines: As the Nawab made good his escape towards Lahore,
The Singhs rushed after him in hot pursuit.
As plenty of treasure landed into S.
Charat Singh's hands,
Many more Singhs joined S.
Charat Singh's contingent.

blocks.text: Dohra:

After S. Charat Singh humbled the Lahore Nawab, Much did the Singhs gain in fame and glory. Thereafter, the Khalsa soldiers crossing the river Chenab, They carried out a slaughter of the Mughals on a massive secale. (16)
lines: After S.
Charat Singh humbled the Lahore Nawab,
Much did the Singhs gain in fame and glory.
Thereafter, the Khalsa soldiers crossing the river Chenab,
They carried out a slaughter of the Mughals on a massive secale.

blocks.text: Chaupai:

As S. Gujjar Singh2 occupied Gujrat3 across the rivers, S. Karam Singh4 took possession of Khavo5 region. As the Shaheed Singh's Misl occupied Sialkot area, Khalsa's prosperity increased day by day. (17)
lines: As S.
Gujjar Singh2 occupied Gujrat3 across the rivers,
S.
Karam Singh4 took possession of Khavo5 region.
As the Shaheed Singh's Misl occupied Sialkot area,
Khalsa's prosperity increased day by day.
